# One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement

Discloser is sharing certain confidential information with Recipient.

## Purpose

Recipient is evaluating a potential commercial relationship with
Discloser and requires access to Discloser's Confidential Information.

## Confidential Information

Information that is non-public, proprietary, or otherwise reasonably
treated as confidential, including business plans, financial data,
product roadmaps, and customer lists.

## Permitted Use

Recipient may use Confidential Information solely to evaluate the
proposed relationship. Any other use is a breach of this Agreement.

## Term

The confidentiality obligations bind Recipient for five (5) years from
the Effective Date.

## Governing Law

Delaware law governs. Disputes resolve in Delaware state or federal
courts.
